newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain cash deficit to grow 10 pct this year - press.
newsitem.headline: Spain cash deficit to grow 10 pct this year - press.

text.p: Spain's cash deficit will increase 10 percent this year, unlike the initial forecast for a 18.5-percent fall, according to Budget department sources quoted in local press reports on Thursday.
However, Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said the overshoot would not keep Spain from reaching its deficit target in National Accounts terms -- those relevant for European single currency requirements.
Under National Accounts terms, the payments made this year are attributed to 1995 accounts.
No one at the Economy Ministry was immediately available to comment.
The government will issue approximately 521 billion pesetas in supplementary debt to cover the shortfall, the reports said.
The difference in the calculations of the cash and budget deficits stems from the budgetary hole of 721 billion pesetas, which belongs to 1995 but will be paid in 1996.
